seasonDescription.summer: and oval leaves with rounded tips

details: A young shrub grows here, a clump of slender stems rising from a common base to stand a little above head height.  The bark is smooth and gray, marked with darker vertical striations.

seasonDetails.winter: The bare, reddish-brown twigs end in narrow, pointed buds sheathed in several overlapping scales.  A few young suckers push up through the leaf litter around the base of the clump.
seasonDetails.spring: The young leaves are oval to nearly round with blunt tips, coarsely toothed above the middle and smooth-edged below, and faintly downy beneath.  Short, crowded racemes of fragrant white flowers open alongside the leaves, each bloom carrying five narrow petals.
seasonDetails.summer: The leaves are oval to nearly round, dull blue-green above and paler beneath, coarsely toothed along the upper half of each margin.
seasonDetails.fall: The leaves have turned to yellow, orange, and red.  They are oval to nearly round, coarsely toothed along the upper half of each margin.

keywords: young saskatoon serviceberry juneberry shrub bush smooth gray bark oval leaves rounded tips stems tree

Harvestable.preDescription: The shrub is hung with clusters of dark purple berries, each dusted with a pale waxy bloom.
Harvestable.postDescription: The shrub has been picked clean of berries.
